source.title: Some open problems concerning Stein spaces

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 61483. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/61483 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the landing page was classified as blocked_or_challenged and treated as a resolver rather than a readable technical source.

Queried https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/61483. The resolver metadata identified Zbl 0754.32007, Mihnea Colţoiu, "Some open problems concerning Stein spaces," Revue Roumaine de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées 36, No. 5-6, pages 225-229 (1991). The API record had links[] empty and no DOI or full-text URL; its review text was used only for identity confirmation, not as extraction evidence.

Ran bounded exact-work recovery using exact-title-plus-PDF, exact-title-plus-author, and Zbl/MR/Rev. Roumaine citation queries. Inspected candidates from the author's IMAR CV/publication list, ResearchGate, IMAR Revue archive search results, reference lists in later exact-citing papers, and the later 2019 article "Some open problems concerning q-convexity and Stein spaces"; accepted none because they were bibliographic listings, abstracts, reference mentions, inaccessible/non-primary pages, or different works rather than readable full text of the 1991 source.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged for the zbMATH landing page and metadata_only or different_work for recovered candidates. No open-problem extraction was performed from metadata, abstracts, resolver review text, search snippets, reference lists, or related works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath_61483.json and outputs/latest.json.
